title: Sky games?
content: Last nights Mallworld dream, a ton of us were playing a sky game, there were blue side, and red side and we were shooting something up to tag drones or something. There was also someone chasing us, every-time we tried to go to a festival in town they were chasing us in the car to try and stop us from going. We did hide down in the car somehow and got there. We did have to pull over a few times and re-hide on the side of the road.Thank you to the taxi driver who let us hide and dropped us off in a safe spot. The festival was super run down, hardly any rides worked, and the rides that did work, there wasn’t chance I was getting on them. The festival was across the street from the haunted hotel (looks like Cecal) oh and the food smelled foul. Why are road trips so freaking difficult, I really wanted to take the train, but it was so full of weirdos!
